description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Heart of the Lion EX Mode] and [Lionheart 0] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Heart of the Lion EX Mode
description.text: Casts Renzokuken Fire Fang after using a Spellblade ability

description.name: Lionheart 0
description.text: Grants [Lionheart 1] after using a Spellblade ability, removed if the character hasn't [Heart of the Lion EX Mode]
